questions.stem: 已經有許多長輩在電話中被騙，這讓他們不敢接陌生的來電。
questions.answer: Many elderly people have been cheated over the phone, and this has made them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
accepted_answers: Many seniors have been tricked on the phone, which has made them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
A lot of elderly people have been cheated over the phone, which makes them afraid to answer unknown calls.

patterns: S + V + O + OC（make + 受詞 + 形容詞）

questions.stem: 警方呼籲長輩，若被要求轉帳，要先和家人確認。
questions.answer: The police urge elderly people to check with their families first if they are asked to transfer money.
accepted_answers: The police advise older people to check with their families first if they are told to transfer money.
The police call on the elderly to confirm with their families first if they are asked to send money.

patterns: 動詞＋受詞＋不定詞（urge sb to V）

1.explanation_zh: 「已經有許多長輩…被騙」的重點是長輩「已經被騙」：以 many elderly people 當主詞，用完成式被動 have been cheated（tricked）；「在電話中」是 over the phone／on the phone。後半句「這讓他們不敢…」是 make + 受詞 + 形容詞（受詞補語）：this has made them afraid to answer …；「不敢」用形容詞 afraid（to VR），不要寫 don't dare。「陌生的來電」是陌生人打來的電話：calls from strangers 或 unknown calls。
evidence: 已經有許多長輩在電話中被騙
這讓他們不敢接陌生的來電
1.strategy_zh: 中文「已經有…被…」先找出真正的主詞，再用完成式被動；「讓＋人＋（感覺）」常用 make + O + adj.。
hints: 切成四段：已經有許多長輩／在電話中被騙／這讓他們不敢／接陌生的來電
標的詞彙：elderly（年長的）、cheat（欺騙，也可用 trick）、phone（電話）、afraid（害怕的）、answer（接〔電話〕）、stranger（陌生人）
句型框架：S + have been + p.p. …, and this has made + O + adj. + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「呼籲／提醒＋人＋做某事」是 urge（或 remind、advise、call on）+ 受詞 + to + 原形動詞：The police urge elderly people to check with their families first；the police 恆用複數動詞，不加 s。「若被要求轉帳」是長輩「被」要求，用被動 if they are asked to transfer money；中文沒有主詞，英文要補 they。「和家人確認」是 check with their families。
2.strategy_zh: 「呼籲／提醒／鼓勵／警告＋人＋做…」先想 V + O + to VR；中文的「被要求」「被告知」用 be asked／be told。
hints: 切成四段：警方呼籲長輩／若被要求／轉帳／要先和家人確認
標的詞彙：police（警方）、urge（呼籲，也可用 remind、advise）、elderly（年長的）、transfer（轉帳）、check（確認；check with）、family（家人）
句型框架：S + urge + O + to VR … if + S + be + asked + to VR

references: Many elderly people have been cheated over the phone, and this has made them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
Many seniors have been tricked on the phone, which has made them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
A lot of elderly people have been cheated over the phone, which makes them afraid to answer unknown calls.

patterns.label_zh: S + V + O + OC（make + 受詞 + 形容詞）
patterns.frame: S + make + O + adj. (+ to VR)

common_errors.wrong: There are many elderly people have
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「已經有許多長輩被騙」的「有」不必譯出；英文一個子句只能有一個主要動詞，直接用 many elderly people 當主詞。
elderly 是形容詞，後面要接 people（或寫成 the elderly）。

accepted: have been cheated over the phone
have been tricked on the phone
have been cheated on the phone
have been fooled over the phone
have been tricked over the phone

common_errors.right: have been cheated over the phone
common_errors.explanation_zh: 長輩是「被」騙，要用完成式被動 have been + 過去分詞；have cheated 是「已經騙了別人」。

common_errors.right: have been cheated over the phone
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「已經」用現在完成式；「在電話中」是 over the phone 或 on the phone。

accepted: and this has made them afraid
and it has made them scared
so this has made them afraid

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「讓＋人＋形容詞」用 make + 受詞 + 形容詞；let 後面要接原形動詞。
make 的受詞補語用形容詞 afraid（不敢＝afraid to）；don't dare 不能接在受詞後面。

accepted: to pick up calls from strangers
to answer calls from unknown numbers
to answer phone calls from strangers

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「陌生的來電」是陌生人打來的電話；strange calls 是「奇怪的電話」。「接電話」用 answer 或 pick up。
stranger 是可數名詞，泛指時用複數。

traps.literal_error: There are already many elderly people have been cheated over the phone.
traps.explanation_zh: 「已經有…被騙」的「有」是存在句，照字面譯成 There are … have been … 會出現兩個主要動詞；直接以 many elderly people 當主詞。

traps.literal_error: Many elderly people have been cheated over the phone, and this let them not dare to receive strange calls.
traps.explanation_zh: 「陌生的來電」是陌生人打來的電話（calls from strangers），strange calls 意思是「奇怪的電話」；「接電話」用 answer。

1.restructuring_zh: 「已經有許多長輩在電話中被騙」不要譯成 There are …，改以 many elderly people 當主詞，用完成式被動 have been cheated（補主詞或改被動）；「這讓他們不敢…」用 this has made them afraid to …。

references: The police urge elderly people to check with their families first if they are asked to transfer money.
The police advise older people to check with their families first if they are told to transfer money.
The police call on the elderly to confirm with their families first if they are asked to send money.

patterns.label_zh: 動詞＋受詞＋不定詞（urge sb to V）
被動語態（被要求…：be asked to VR）

accepted: The police call on the elderly

common_errors.explanation_zh: police 是複數名詞，動詞不加 s。

common_errors.wrong: The police urge elderly people that
common_errors.right: The police urge elderly people to
common_errors.explanation_zh: urge／advise／call on + 受詞後面接 to + 原形動詞，不接 that 子句。
長輩是「被」要求，用被動 be asked；if they ask 變成長輩去要求別人。
「若被要求」沒有主詞，英文子句要補上 they。
「轉帳」是把錢轉出去：transfer money；account 是帳戶。

accepted: to check with their families first
to confirm with their families first
to check with their family members first
to talk to their families first

common_errors.wrong: must check with their families first
common_errors.right: to check with their families first
common_errors.explanation_zh: urge／advise + 受詞後面接 to + 原形動詞，不能直接接助動詞 must。

common_errors.right: to check with their families first
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「和家人確認」是 check with sb；check sb 是「檢查某人」。

traps.literal_error: The police urge elderly people if be asked to transfer money, must check with family first.
traps.explanation_zh: 「若被要求轉帳」「要先和家人確認」都沒有主詞，英文條件子句要補 they；後半用 urge + 受詞 + to VR 最簡潔。

traps.literal_error: The police urge elderly people to check with their families first if they are asked to transfer account.
traps.explanation_zh: 「轉帳」是把錢轉出去，英文是 transfer money；transfer account 意思不對。

2.restructuring_zh: 「若被要求轉帳，要先和家人確認」兩個子句都沒有主詞：改用 urge + 長輩 + to check …，條件子句補上主詞 they 並用被動 are asked。

1.translation: Many elderly people have already been scammed over the phone, which makes them afraid to answer calls from strangers.
1.explanation_zh: 「已經有許多長輩被騙」用現在完成式被動 have already been scammed；「這讓他們…」以非限定關係代名詞 , which 承接整個前句；「不敢接陌生的來電」譯 afraid to answer calls from strangers。

2.translation: The police urge elderly people to check with their family members first if they are asked to transfer money.
2.explanation_zh: 「呼籲某人做某事」用 urge sb to V；「若被要求轉帳」用 if 條件子句加被動 are asked to transfer money；「先和家人確認」譯 check with their family members first。

「已經」三個參考譯文都只靠完成式表達，accepted 沒有 have already been cheated 這類寫法，建議補一條。

issues_zh: 「被騙」我自然寫成 have been scammed（電話詐騙最常見的說法），但 target_words 的 cheat 的 alternatives（trick、fool）和第 2 部分「在電話中被騙」的 accepted 都沒收 scam／be scammed／be defrauded，所以這一句只命中 5/6 個標的詞彙。語意沒問題，建議把 scam 補進 cheat 的 alternatives 與該部分的 accepted，避免學生寫 scammed 被誤判。

status_reason: 判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：record_verification 判 verified，但判定改為退回，評分規準太窄。第 1 題的主題就是電話詐騙，「在電話中被騙」最常見而且正確的 have been scammed over the phone，不在標的詞彙 cheat 的 alternatives（只有 trick／fool），也不在第 2 部分 accepted；兩位驗證者都獨立譯成 have (already) been scammed，也都以 parts_check warn 指出（程式因此只算命中 5/6 個標的詞），deceive／defraud 同樣沒收，學生寫出最道地的 scammed 照規準會在第 2 部分被扣分。另外第 2 部分 accepted 沒有帶 already 的 have already been cheated（「已經」是題目的字，兩位驗證者都寫了 already）；第 2 題第 4 部分沒收 check with their family first（family 當集合名詞，驗證者 B 的寫法）。修訂時把 scam 補進 cheat 的 alternatives 與第 2 部分 accepted（have been scammed over the phone／on the phone），並補 have already been cheated／scammed、check with their family first。
